title: Wedding Alcohol Calculator: Bottles, Cases & Cost (2026)
description: 100 guests, 4 hours: about 40 bottles of wine, 8 of liquor, 4 cases of beer. Type your guests for bottles and cost at Sep 2026 US average prices.
refresh_note: Wine and beer prices re-read from the BLS monthly average price release.
answer_html:
As of Oct 29, 2026: for 100 guests and a 4-hour full bar, buy about 40 bottles of wine, 8 bottles of liquor and 4 cases of beer: 400 drinks, one per guest per hour.

The wine and beer cost about $548 at US average store prices (BLS, Sep 2026). Type your own numbers below.

sources.quote: The typical school of thought is to plan one drink per hour per guest.
For a full open bar, estimate the quantity to be 50 percent wine, 30 percent liquor, and 20 percent beer consumption.
If you’re only serving beer and wine, it’s common to calculate the percentages to be 75 percent wine and 25 percent beer.

faq.q: How much alcohol do I need for 100 wedding guests?
faq.a: For a 4-hour full bar at one drink per guest per hour (400 drinks): about 40 bottles of wine, 8 bottles of liquor (750 ml) and 4 cases of 24 beers. That uses Zola's split of 50% wine, 30% liquor and 20% beer. Add 13 bottles of sparkling if you want a toast.

faq.q: How many bottles of wine for a wedding of 100?
faq.a: 40 bottles for a 4-hour full bar: 200 glasses at 5 glasses a bottle. If you serve only beer and wine, 60 bottles: Zola's split gives wine 75% of the 400 drinks, 300 glasses.

faq.q: How many drinks per person at a wedding?
faq.a: Plan one drink per guest per hour: Zola calls it the typical rule, and Joy's calculator uses it as its "average". Joy's "heavy" setting is two an hour. So a 4-hour reception is about 4 drinks a guest.

faq.q: How much champagne for a toast for 100 guests?
faq.a: 13 bottles: one flute per guest at 8 flutes a bottle (Zola). 100 divided by 8 is 12.5, rounded up to 13.

faq.q: How much does wedding alcohol cost?
faq.a: At September 2026 US average store prices (Bureau of Labor Statistics), wine is about $10.33 a 750 ml bottle and beer $33.75 a case of 24. The wine and beer for 100 guests and a 4-hour full bar come to about $548. Liquor depends on your brand: type its price in the calculator.
